Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, m As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set m = wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1).CodeModule
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        m.AddFromString "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    Case 1
        m.AddFromString "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    Case 2
        m.AddFromString "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x, _" & vbCrLf & "y)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    Case 3
        m.AddFromString "Sub A( _" & vbCrLf & ")" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Sub B( _" & vbCrLf & ")" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    Case 4
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "x = 1 + _" & vbCrLf & "2" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    Case 5
        m.InsertLines 1, "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    Case 6
        m.AddFromString "Dim a As _" & vbCrLf & "Long" & vbCrLf
    Case 7
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.AddFromString "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    Case 8
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.InsertLines 3, "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    Case 9
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.InsertLines 3, "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    Case 10
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.InsertLines 1, "Function G( _" & vbCrLf & "x)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf
    Case 11
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.InsertLines 2, "x = 1 + _" & vbCrLf & "2"
    Case 12
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf: m.InsertLines 2, "x = 1 + _" & vbCrLf & "2"
    Case 13
        m.InsertLines 1, "x = 1 + _"
    Case 14
        m.InsertLines 1, "Sub A( _" & vbCrLf & ")" & vbCrLf & "End Sub": m.DeleteLines 1, 1
    Case 15
        m.AddFromString "Sub A()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
    End Select
    Tried = m.CountOfLines
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsm", xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
